messages:
Alex M: Heads up — eu-central GPUs are flapping hard, cluster-autoscaler spamming scale events. Seeing a huge backlog of pending pods in inference-queue.
Priya K: Oof. Any obvious offender? job/controller retry storm?
Alex M: Looks like a cron job (nightly-embed-refresh) started retrying massively after a transient DB timeout at ~02:03. The job has backoffLimit misconfigured (0 -> immediate restart).
Chao: Can you paste autoscaler events? I want to see scale down/scale up timestamps.
Alex M: 
Infra Bot: ```
I0422 02:05:11 autoscaler.go:123] scaleUp: target=0->12 nodes (requested 11)
I0422 02:05:45 autoscaler.go:123] scaleUp: target=12->24 nodes (requested 12)
I0422 02:06:09 autoscaler.go:123] scaleUp: target=24->48 nodes (requested 24)
I0422 02:07:30 autoscaler.go:456] scaleDown: skipping, recent scale-up
I0422 02:08:02 nodecontroller.go:78] node(s) NotReady -> taint: gpu-attach-failure
``` 
Alex M: Also seeing ENI attach failures on a subset of the new instances. Spot interruption rate spiked (we're using mixed-spot in that pool).
Viv (ops): So two issues: runaway cron retries + spot churn + autoscaler amplifying. Classic feedback loop.
Priya K: Immediate mitigation: pause the cron and scale policy adjustments. Who can pause the k8s CronJob? k8s-oncall?
k8s-oncall: I can patch it. Executing: `kubectl patch cronjob nightly-embed-refresh -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'`
k8s-oncall: patched. cronjob suspended.
Chao: Nice. We should also throttle the job queue ingress — FLIGHT-QUEUE rate limiter to 25 r/s. Priya, can you flip the limiter?
Priya K: Done, set limiter to 25r/s and added a temporary 30s retry jitter for the job worker.
Alex M: I'm going to cordon the spot-heavy nodepool to stop more launches: `kubectl annotate nodegroup eu-gpu-spot lifecycle=cordoned` and patch autoscaler to exclude that nodepool from scale up.
Viv (ops): I'm creating a fallback on-demand nodepool (eu-gpu-fallback-ond) with larger instances (a2.large-like) and setting max surge to 10 nodes. Will bind the highest-priority workloads there.
Infra Bot: Fallback pool created: eu-gpu-fallback-ond (10 nodes, on-demand). Routing policy updated.
Chao: Also bumping autoscaler stabilization windows: scaleUp: 3m -> 6m, scaleDown disabled for 10m. This should damp the oscillation.
k8s-oncall: Confirmed: CA config updated. Added annotation to cronjob to remind to fix backoffLimit.
Priya K: Pushed a quick patch to the Job template to set `backoffLimit: 6` and `restartPolicy: OnFailure`. Will follow up with a PR to remove the bug.
Alex M: Monitoring: pending pods dropped from 1.2k -> 120 in 10m. Node provisioning throttles reduced. ENI attach errors still trickling but less frequent.
Viv (ops): Cost note — fallback on-demand pool will add ~$3k/day while we stabilize. Flagging for finance.
Chao: Post-incident todos: 1) Fix cron template PR 2) Add canary and rate-limit for all heavy cronjobs 3) Autoscaler tuning doc update 4) Incident playbook entry for spot-churn + retry storms.
Alex M: Good. I'll open the incident postmortem and link logs + timelines. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
k8s-oncall: marking channel as incident-resolved but keeping thread open for postmortem inputs.
